text: Completed production optimizer integration. LM/GN is now the default pair strategy with target-frame SE(3) retraction, explicit validated damping, separate objective/gradient/physical-step convergence, strict monotone accepted-objective traces, exact termination cases, typed non-finite failures, and reusable streaming normal accumulation. Coordinate search remains only RigidOptimizationStrategy.ReferenceCoordinateSearch. Deterministic axial capture is typed and recorded; the five-case -12/-6/0/6/12 degree court is 5/5 with and without capture at 0.10 mm/0.20 deg, deterministic on JVM/JS, and improves the +12 boundary from 0.17501 to 0.15921 deg. The unchanged six-DOF gate passes at 0.001717 mm and 0.043979 deg; E_identity=0.0224215080449, E_truth=0.0000183389187827, E_recovered=0.0000181944425078. Multiscale uses filtered GridTower levels and physical continuation; series retains reference anchoring and neighbor warm starts; template refresh now retains the named ValidityWeightedMean statistic. Full gates: motion 39 JVM/36 JS, register 4 JVM/4 JS, no failures; JVM nontrivial LM fit allocates 208048 B over 11 scans at 20.175 MVox/s, and the primitive kernel remains 88 B at both 512 and 32768 samples. PRD/build DAG and 558-symbol uniqueness validators pass. Type-discipline review is clean; guides and status ledger updated.
